integrity.method: Read-only SHA256 per-file digest manifest equal to the registry pin; no source files modified

rule: Most APPROVED documents with the target metric <= target; ties prefer less over-redaction. Validation data only.

selected_metrics.definition: A gold character leaks when no applied transformation covers its source offset. Over-redaction is the share of non-whitespace, non-gold characters that a transformation covered. Direct identifiers: ADDRESS, API_KEY, AUTH_TOKEN, BANK_ACCOUNT, CLABE, CREDENTIAL, CURP, CUSTOMER_ID, DATE_OF_BIRTH, EMAIL, EMPLOYEE_ID, INSURANCE_ID, IP_ADDRESS, NATIONAL_ID, PASSPORT, PATIENT_ID, PAYMENT_CARD, PERSON, PHONE, REGIONAL_ID, RFC; every other category counts as a quasi-identifier.
